coverageGap.why: this check reads the PAPER path (simulation_jobs joined to execution_observations). Trajectory legs run inside the sequential runtime and do not write a canonical settlement per leg, so trajectory net PnL is UNKNOWN rather than computed.
coverageGap.consequence: pnpm readiness FAILS on that UNKNOWN rather than substituting the gross delta the outcomes table carries. Gross is exit mark minus entry cash-out and contains no unrecoverable rent, no failed attempt, no claim cost and no cashback.
